The '''Gelviddis Cluster''' was a [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] that contained a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with sands that the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] discovered would [[Sand levitation|assume the shape]] of what an observer was thinking.
